summary: Global Ship Lease, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 10, 2026 press release announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend on its 8.75% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Shares. The board declared $0.546875 per depositary share, each representing a 1/100th interest, covering July 1 to September 30, 2026, payable October 1, 2026 to holders of record September 24, 2026. No special-situation transaction, stake, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is implicated; this is an ordinary dividend declaration by a Marshall Islands-incorporated, NYSE-listed containership lessor. Watch for continued preferred coverage and redemption optionality, not deal terms.
